question: According to the Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, which was the poorest state?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bihar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) of 2022 was released by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
 
• It was first launched in 2010.
 
• India has the largest number of poor people followed by Nigeria.
 
• Bihar is the poorest state in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
